contract.name: casepath_observable_claim
contract.rule: Pass this object—and only this object—to downstream inference.

customer_message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam

For this exceptional situation: The form was in my mailbox yesterday but demands the higher rent from the first of this month; I discarded the envelope; The lease lists several dates, and I do not know which one applies; this is how I recorded it.

Regarding “officially notified increase with an apparently retroactive start and uncertain receipt evidence”, my notes show: the actual receipt date remains unresolved; for the request “reconstruct receipt, the effective date and applicable notice dates, and preserve the challenge deadline”: I currently have only part of the records; on “officially notified increase with an apparently retroactive start and uncertain receipt evidence”, I need a concise assessment first; also unresolved: the applicable notice date; this defines the scope of my report.

I am specifically asking for: reconstruct receipt, the effective date and applicable notice dates, and preserve the challenge deadline; in particular, I need clarity about the applicable notice date and how the exceptional circumstance changes the route.

My first note about it is dated 24 September 2025.

Thank you for reviewing carefully; Before acting I need to know the actual receipt date; I need that answer before proceeding.

Yours sincerely
customer_message.subject: Unusual circumstances: officially notified increase with an apparently retroactive start and uncertain receipt evidence
